The court colour is a little desaturated and hazy compared with A. The net is drawn as a solid opaque black band, so it reads heavy and hides the court surface behind it. The far player is small. Otherwise it is polished: full colourful crowd stands, readable AURA SLAM and WORLD TOUR banners, proper cast shadows and good depth.

Still, it has a clear lunar mood: a planet in the sky, a full crowd, a THE MOON scoreboard, strong shadows and a readable court.
